text_block_list.text:
『It can't be anyone else but me』,
you say…… 
but, why do you think that about me……?

『It can't be anyone else but me』,
you say…… 
but, why do you think that about me……?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……The truth is,
we already knew about you before we enrolled
here.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……that you were following in the footsteps
of your 
『Famous』 father by becoming the trainer of
Team <Ascella>.

(Honestly――I wasn't surprised that they
knew. 
After all,
it was quite the news story at the time.)

As someone who possessed a keen intuition
in regards to 
Uma Musume, able to guide them skillfully,
my father became 
『Famous』 as someone who raised many strong
Uma Musume.

He became a leading trainer at a young
age. 
He has now decided to retire and going
forward…… 
I will be taking over his team, <Ascella>.

He became a leading trainer at a young
age. 
He has now decided to retire and going
forward…… 
I will be taking over his team, <Ascella>.

Obviously, it attracted alot of attention.
After that, I 
formed a contract with King Halo,
whose mother was also famous.
It had earned us the nickname 『Second
Generation Duo』.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
On remaining undefeated and winning your
first 
major race, congratulations! After this,
are your 
plans to enter the Classic Triple Crown
rotation!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
The 『Satsuki Sho』『Japan Derby』 and 『Kikka
Sho』, 
I will,
without fail win the Triple Crown races――

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Without fail,
I will show you results befitting of 
being called first rate. Please,
look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
For next year's Classic Triple Crown,
Special Week, 
who is being led by the New Age 『Genius』
trainer, 
has also announced their participation!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Many people seem to think that Team <Ascella>
and the 『Genius』 
team are rivals,
are you confident that you can win!?

This is not a battle between trainers,
it is a battle between 
Uma Musume,
and I'd like you to keep that in mind,
however――

Of course I have confidence.
……that is a reflection of 
the trust I put in King Halo,
a first rate Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
As expected……!
We're looking forward to the continued 
success of the 『Second Generation Duo』,
following in 
the footsteps of their renowned parents.
But……

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……it's finally the 『Japan Derby』 isn't
it……?

(Not good……King looks really uneasy……I wanted
to give her some 
advice so she could be more confident and
positive……but……!)

(Not good……King looks really uneasy……I wanted
to give her some 
advice so she could be more confident and
positive……but……!)

(Honestly……I'm not sure what to tell her! 
At Satsuki, Seiun Sky got us good,
so I want 
her to be cautious of the front but――)

(Honestly……I'm not sure what to tell her! 
At Satsuki, Seiun Sky got us good,
so I want 
her to be cautious of the front but――)

(There's also Special Week from behind too!
If she focused too much on the front,
she'd exhaust herself 
before the end and it would be all
over……!)

(So then what should I do? What should I say?
What position 
should she take, who should she mark,
how should she run……!?)

(So then what should I do? What should I say?
What position 
should she take, who should she mark,
how should she run……!?)

(Damnit, damnit, damnit! Why can't I 
think of anything!? Even though I'm……!)

(Damnit, damnit, damnit! Why can't I 
think of anything!? Even though I'm……!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
W-wait……what's wrong? 
Don't make a face like that right
before……Hey――!

text_block_list.name: Race Official
text_block_list.text:
――Excuse me. 
King Halo-san,
it's time.
Please make your way to the paddock.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah…… 
……I need to get going……

(I'm out of time……!
I wasn't……able to say anything……!!)

(I'm out of time……!
I wasn't……able to say anything……!!)

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, the 『Japan Derby』 finally――starts!! 
18 Uma Musume run for their dreams,
for that crown!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(I need to win, I need to win,
I need to win! 
I need to win, I…… ……!?)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(Ah……eh……? Front? 
W-what am I doing here……?)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: (No way……my mind……just went blank……!?)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……!! 
Haaa, haaa, haaa, haaa――!!

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's Special Week! It's Special Week!
She pulls far 
away from them all,
Special Week crosses the goal!!

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The prestige of the 『Japan Derby』! 
In this 『Japan Derby』,
Special Week has claimed victory!!

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
――She was the second favorite,
but King Halo was defeated 
back in to 14th place!
It's the first time she's run as an 
escape since her debut,
but the results were unfortunate!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Haa……Haaaa……~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey,
hey! What is the 『Second Generation Duo』
doing!? 
They just got crushed by that 『Genius
Trainer』's team!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
And……why did she run as an escape?
Did she panic? 
Or was it her trainer's orders? Either way,
it wasn't great.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
In the end, second gen was just second rate,
huh.

(After that,
we lost two more major races, 
including the 『Kikka Sho』.
Her classic year 
ended with us not living up to
expectations――)

(After that,
we lost two more major races, 
including the 『Kikka Sho』.
Her classic year 
ended with us not living up to
expectations――)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……Looks like there's no articles about Team
<Ascella> 
today either. Well, even if there were,
all the 
latest articles have been disparaging us
though.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……I suppose that just means the world has
finally 
lost interest in the Unreliable Second Gen
Duo……

(I was pathetic. I just wanted to disappear.
Due to my 
incompetence,
King's once-in-a-lifetime Classic year……)

(I was pathetic. I just wanted to disappear.
Due to my 
incompetence,
King's once-in-a-lifetime Classic year……)

(Don't just apologize. Don't let go.
……Don't run from it! 
I am King Halo's trainer!)

(Don't just apologize. Don't let go.
……Don't run from it! 
I am King Halo's trainer!)

King. ……for your next race,
how does the 『Yasuda Kinen』 sound? 
I want to utilize your best weapon,
your speed.

King. ……for your next race,
how does the 『Yasuda Kinen』 sound? 
I want to utilize your best weapon,
your speed.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: By next…… You mean――

I know it hurts.
Honestly it must feel awful. 
……But you, even then,
you aren't an Uma Musume 
who will give up so easily, right?

I know it hurts.
Honestly it must feel awful. 
……But you, even then,
you aren't an Uma Musume 
who will give up so easily, right?

Even if someone looks at you with
disappointment, even if 
they tell you it's impossible. Never,
not until the day you 
can hold your head up high as a 『First Rate
Uma Musume』!

Even if someone looks at you with
disappointment, even if 
they tell you it's impossible. Never,
not until the day you 
can hold your head up high as a 『First Rate
Uma Musume』!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……~~~, isn't that obvious!? 
The thought of giving up,
of it ending like this, I hate it!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So start preparing,
Trainer! We're having a meeting 
about the next race!
Just for you――I'll give you the 
privilege of supporting King's new path!

From then on,
we continued on. Even when they 
pointed and laughed at us,
we kept running forward.

『Yasuda Kinen』『Takarazuka Kinen』『Tenno Sho
(Autumn)』 
『Mile CS』『Sprinter's S』『February S』……

We lost, tried again,
and lost again. Just hanging 
on desperately. On the grandest stage.
G1 Races. 
Everything for the sake of winning there.

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She comes flying from the outside,
King Halo! 
It's King Halo!
King Halo breezes past them all!!

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
First place is King Halo!
Overcoming 10 defeats, now, at the 
『Takamatsunomiya Kinen』 King Halo obtains
her first G1 victory!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Uu……Uwaaaaaaaaaaah!!

(King Halo lets out a yell.
That brilliance is 
just proof that she's a first rate Uma
Musume. 
There was nobody who could doubt that
now!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
――……I'm thankful for the many words of
congratulations. 
To be honest,
it hasn't been an easy road but……

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To be able to continue running,
without giving up……! 
Has made……me incredibly happy……!

(Afterwards……when we watched the broadcast,
King 
and I both argued 『No,
you were crying harder』)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
――……it was powerful, and moved me. 
During that press conference,
both of you……looked so strong.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu. ……Actually,
both of us were watching 
that press conference on the street
billboards! 
And we happened to be next to each other!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's where me and Cesario had both decided.
That someday, 
we'd definitely join King-san and Trainer-san's
team.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
To never give up on your dream until the
very end. No matter how painful,
or frustrating, 
to keep running until you've taken hold of
it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To stay on that journey together.
Working together to carve open a path.
Seeing the two of you like 
that……I admired you from the bottom of my
heart.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……that's why Kraft and I chose Team
<Ascella>. 
There is no better team for us,
is what we believe.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That if Trainer-san is with us,
then we can keep going, never giving up.
Until we take hold of our dreams, no 
matter how painful it is,
we can keep running……!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……geez,
I was wondering what you were talking
about. 
And you,
you should be more proud of yourself too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……even though we were thrown off the path
we 
were expected to take,
that we had prepared for!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if we weren't able to leave the results
expected of the 
children of a famous Uma Musume and a famous
trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if we weren't able to leave the results
expected of the 
children of a famous Uma Musume and a famous
trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That we were able to do something so like
us――that only we could do,
being able to obtain a first rate result. 
Just who else do you think this was thanks
to?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The reason I was able to hold my head high
and keep running…… 
just who was it that stuck by my side and
made it possible?

――I'm pathetic.
I gave King Halo a bitter smile, 
and turned back to Rhein Kraft and
Cesario.

Kraft, Cesario. 
……I'm really thankful that you chose Team
<Ascella>.

I'm not as great as my dad. 
I may only have inherited his stubbornness.
But still――
choice_data_list: I'll support you until the end
I'll support you until the end

text_block_list.text:
I'm not as great as my dad. 
I may only have inherited his stubbornness.
But still――
choice_data_list: I'll support you until the end
I'll support you until the end

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san……!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. 
……Once again, I'm looking forward to it!
